data.description: Experience a lifestyle intertwined with nature, complemented by top-notch amenities at The Meadows Dubai.

data.answer:
The Meadows is known for its lush green landscapes, tranquil surroundings, and spacious villas. The Meadows has nine sub-communities, many offering shared facilities such as parks, playgrounds, tennis courts, and communal pools for residents to enjoy. Here are the names of the sub-districts in the larger Meadows community:

  • Meadows 1 Dubai
  • Meadows 2
  • Meadows 3
  • Meadows 4
  • Meadows 5
  • Meadows 6
  • Meadows 7
  • Meadows 8
  • Meadows 9 Dubai

Among these, Meadows 1 Dubai, Meadows 2, and Meadows 9 are the most popular ones. All these communities have a distinct architectural style and separate entry points.

All sub-districts in The Meadows Dubai have 3 to 7-bedroom villas. Many Meadows Villas consist of two levels and offer private pools or views of the golf course.

Properties for Rent in Meadows Dubai Properties

Rentals for properties in Meadows by Emaar typically commence at AED 315,000 annually. These rental options include independent villas ranging from 3 to 6 bedrooms. On average, a 3-bedroom villa rental is priced around AED 315,000, while 4-bedroom villas start at AED 350,000. Opting for larger accommodations such as 5-bedroom villas will result in annual costs increasing to approximately AED 375,000, while 6-bedroom family homes start from AED 569,000 per annum.

Properties for Sale in Meadows Location

The initial sales prices for 3-bedroom Meadows villas for sale start at AED 6.5 million, while 4-bedroom villas begin at AED 6.7 million. These properties offer covered spaces ranging from 3,500 sq. ft. to 4,700 sq. ft. For those interested in larger units, there are 5-bedroom freehold villas available, spanning approximately 4,900 sq. ft., with an average price of AED 7.8 million. Additionally, 6-bedroom villas Meadows Dubai for sale are priced from AED 9.2M.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Dubai Meadows?

data.answer:
Life in Dubai Meadows offers a blend of tranquility, convenience, and community spirit. Nestled within lush landscapes and spacious villas, residents enjoy a serene environment ideal for families and individuals seeking a peaceful retreat from the city's hustle and bustle. The well-maintained amenities, including parks, playgrounds, and community pools, provide opportunities for leisure and recreation. Additionally, the proximity to shopping centers and dining options ensures convenience, while the sense of community fosters social connections and a vibrant neighborhood atmosphere. With its picturesque surroundings, amenities, and family-friendly ambiance, Dubai Meadows offers a fulfilling lifestyle characterized by comfort, relaxation, and a strong sense of belonging.

Public Transportation in Meadows Dubai Properties

Meadows Dubai has no metro stations within the community. The closest metro stations, including Dubai Sobha Realty Metro Station and the DMCC Metro Station, are approximately a 10-minute drive away. However, convenient RTA Bus services, such as the F31 route, are available with frequent stops in key areas of the community and along the main road.

Supermarkets in Meadows

At Spinneys Meadows, you can find all grocery items and other daily essentials. For everyday grocery needs, residents can visit the Spinney’s outlet in the Town Centre or the Milk & Honey Gourmet branch. Additionally, there is a Life Pharmacy in the community. Residents can head to the Carrefour hypermarket at the Mall of the Emirates for a broader selection.

Shopping Malls in and near Meadows

While Meadows Dubai doesn't have traditional malls, residents have access to The Meadows Souk, serving as the community's shopping and leisure hub. The souk offers a supermarket, pet shop, jewelry stores, children's shops, dining options, beauty salons, and a gym outlet, catering to various needs. The Meadows Village further enhances the neighborhood's retail and dining offerings. Nearby malls like Mall of the Emirates and City Centre Me’aisem are reachable within 20 minutes.

Schools in and Near Meadows

For young children, options include Kids Kingdom Nursery in IMPZ, the Amity Early Learning Centre, and Jebel Ali Village Nursery in The Lakes nearby. Other schools in Meadows include Emirates International School Meadows and Dubai British School.

The Emirates International School Meadows is a popular school in the area. EIS Meadows children aged 3 to 18 receive exceptional international education spanning from Early Years to Year 13. The curriculum at Emirates School Meadows is renowned for its excellence, adhering closely to IB standards. Beginning with the Primary Years Programme (PYP), students progress seamlessly through the Middle Years Programme (MYP) before culminating in the prestigious IB Diploma Programme (DP). Dubai British School, located in Emirates Hills, follows the British curriculum and is highly regarded.

For university education, Meadows Dubai is close to Dubai Knowledge Park, which hosts prestigious institutions like Middlesex University and the University of Bradford Dubai, among others.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Meadows Area 

Muslim residents can visit Al Wahab Mosque or Al Samad Mosque in Meadows Dubai for prayers. The nearest churches, Metropolitan Mark Chords and the International Nepalese Community Church, are approximately a 15-minute drive away. Guru Nanak Darbar in Jebel Ali is the nearest Sikh place of worship, also about a 15-minute drive away. Hindu residents may need to travel approximately 35 minutes to reach temples in the Bur Dubai area, such as Shree Krishna Haveli.

Clinics and Hospitals In and Near Meadows Sheikh Zayed Road Dubai

Residents of this community have convenient access to top-tier medical services without needing to travel far. Proximity to leading clinics in Dubai ensures prompt and reliable healthcare. Mediclinic Meadows, located within the community, offers comprehensive medical facilities. The Al Garhoud Private Hospital Clinic in Jumeirah Islands is also nearby and easily reachable. Al Zahra Hospital in Al Barsha is just a 12-minute drive away for more extensive medical needs.

Meadows Location & Nearby Areas

As part of the Emirates Living communities, Meadows Dubai is near The Springs, The Lakes, and the Emirates Hills. Meadows shares a border with Jumeirah Islands and Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT) and provides easy access to major hubs in the city, such as Dubai Marina, Dubai Internet City, Dubai Media City, and Dubai Knowledge Park.

In Meadows Dubai, residents can engage in various activities suited to various interests and lifestyles. Nature enthusiasts can explore the picturesque surroundings through leisurely walks or picnics in the community's green spaces. Fitness enthusiasts can use well-equipped gyms and community sports facilities for workouts and recreational sports. Additionally, residents can socialize with neighbors at community events or unwind with family and friends at local cafes and restaurants. Whether seeking relaxation, outdoor adventure, or community connection, Meadows Dubai offers diverse options to enrich daily life.

Restaurants in and Near Meadows Dubai

Residents and visitors can indulge in various dining options, catering to diverse tastes and preferences. Puranmal Meadows offers a delightful culinary experience with authentic Indian cuisine featuring a rich blend of flavors and spices. For those craving flavorful fried chicken, Texas Chicken Meadows serves up crispy and succulent chicken dishes that are sure to satisfy any appetite. Meanwhile, Meadows Subway provides a fresh and convenient option for sandwich lovers, with a menu boasting a wide selection of subs made with quality ingredients. Whether you're in the mood for traditional Indian delicacies, hearty American fare, or a quick and tasty sandwich, the dining scene in and near Meadows Dubai has something for everyone to enjoy.

Beaches Near Meadows Location

While Meadows does not have beaches, popular beach destinations like Barasti Beach and JBR Beach are conveniently located within a short drive, less than 10 and 17 minutes away, respectively.

Hotels in the Meadows Dubai Area

There are no hotels in the Meadows area, but you can find good options around a 30-minute drive away. Vida Emirates Hills is within a 28-minute distance from the neighborhood, while Address Montgomerie is slightly away at a 32-minute driving distance. 
Address Montgomerie 32 minutes

Attractions and Landmarks Near Meadows

Residents benefit from priority membership at the neighboring Montgomerie golf course, known for its championship golf course designed by Colin Montgomerie. The Montgomerie offers a fantastic link-style course, consistently ranked among the top courses in the Middle East.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

In Meadows Dubai, as in other Emirates Living communities, an outdoor lifestyle is actively promoted, fostering a culture of fitness and well-being within its thoughtfully crafted environment. Fitness enthusiasts can engage in their workout routines at Fitness First Meadows or Fitness First Meadows Village, both offering state-of-the-art facilities and expert guidance to help individuals achieve their fitness goals. Additionally, residents can pamper themselves and relax at Tips and Toes Meadows Village Day Spa, providing a range of beauty and wellness services designed to rejuvenate the mind and body. With a focus on promoting holistic wellness and an active lifestyle, Meadows Dubai ensures that residents have access to top-notch amenities and facilities to support their health and fitness journey.
Meadows is primarily residential, and public transportation options are limited compared to urban areas. This could pose challenges for residents who rely on public transport for daily commuting.

Are Springs and Meadows the same?

While both Springs and Meadows are part of the Emirates Living communities in Dubai, they are distinct residential areas with their own unique characteristics. The Springs is a gated villa community known for its serene lakes, lush landscaping, and family-friendly atmosphere, offering a range of townhouses and villas surrounded by landscaped gardens and recreational facilities.

On the other hand, Meadows is also a gated villa community located nearby. It features spacious villas nestled amidst greenery and offers a tranquil suburban lifestyle. While both communities share proximity and similar amenities such as parks, playgrounds, and retail centers, they maintain their identities and charm, catering to the different preferences and lifestyles of residents seeking a quality living experience in Dubai.

Does Meadows have a community pool?

Meadows 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, and 8 are equipped with community pools, all meticulously maintained and supervised by lifeguards during operational hours. Residents can also take advantage of BBQ and picnic areas scattered throughout the community for additional outdoor enjoyment.

Are there any off-plan projects at Meadows Dubai Properties? 

Currently, there are no off-plan properties in the area.

What is the distance from the Meadows to the DXB?

It takes roughly 25 minutes to reach Dubai International Airport from the community.

Are there parking spaces in The Meadows?

The Meadows in Dubai provides ample parking spaces for residents, ensuring convenience and accessibility within the community. Each villa typically includes designated parking areas, with options for covered or open parking spaces depending on the property type. Additionally, visitors to The Meadows can find designated guest parking areas strategically located throughout the neighborhood, facilitating ease of access for guests and enhancing the overall convenience of parking within this well-planned residential area.

What amenities are available in Meadows?

Meadows Dubai offers a variety of amenities designed to enhance residents' lifestyles, including parks, landscaped gardens, swimming pools, children's play areas, BBQ areas, and sports facilities such as tennis courts and basketball courts. There are also community centers with retail outlets, supermarkets, cafes, and restaurants.

What types of properties are available in Meadows Dubai?

Meadows Dubai features primarily detached and semi-detached villas in various configurations, ranging from 3 to 7 bedrooms. These villas are known for their spacious layouts, lush surroundings, and upscale finishes, catering to families and individuals seeking a tranquil yet well-connected residential environment.

Who is the developer of The Meadows?

The Meadows development in Dubai is developed by Emaar Properties, one of the UAE's leading real estate developers known for creating prestigious and master-planned communities across Dubai.

How is transportation in The Meadows?

Transportation in The Meadows is convenient, with well-connected road networks providing easy access to major highways such as Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road. Residents typically rely on private vehicles for commuting, although public transport options such as taxis and ride-hailing services are readily available for transportation within and beyond the community.

data.content:
The Meadows Dubai is a project of Emaar Properties, a part of Emirates Living. It is a gated community consisting of spacious villas. Surrounded by parks and lakes, The Meadows villas offer plenty of facilities to its residents, including retail spaces, sports court, swimming pools, and restaurants.

Located near Montgomerie Golf Course, Meadows is one of the popular golf communities in Dubai. Residents enjoy easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) and areas like Emirates Hills, Dubai Marina, The Springs, and JLT.

The neighborhood has many family-friendly amenities, such as outdoor spaces, schools, and clinics. In Meadows Dubai, you can find various properties for sale and rent.
